import os, json

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {'node_modules','node_modules-full','.git','.rork','__pycache__','.tmp-frames','.tmp-ivx-frames','dist','home','.github'}
EXCLUDE_PREFIXES = ('ivx_20step_','ivx_acceptance_test','phase1_test','cert_test.py','web_qa_')
EXCLUDE_FILES = {'.env.example','.gitignore','.gitattributes','.gitmodules','bun.lock','GATE4_RORK_HISTORY_PURGE.md','PROJECT_SEPARATION.md','IVX_CRITICAL_FILES_MANIFEST.json'}

files = []
for root, dirs, fnames in os.walk('.'):
    dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in EXCLUDE_DIRS]
    for f in fnames:
        rel = os.path.join(root, f)[2:]
        if any(rel.startswith(p) for p in EXCLUDE_PREFIXES): continue
        if rel in EXCLUDE_FILES: continue
        if rel.endswith(('.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.gif','.webp','.ico')): continue
        files.append(rel)
files.sort()

github_set = set(json.load(open('/tmp/gh_tree.json')))
local_set = set(files)
missing = sorted(local_set - github_set)
present = local_set & github_set

print(f"TOTAL_EXPECTED={len(local_set)}")
print(f"TOTAL_PRESENT={len(present)}")
print(f"MISSING_COUNT={len(missing)}")
if missing:
    print("=== MISSING FILE PATHS ===")
    for f in missing: print(f)
    json.dump(missing, open('/tmp/truly_missing.json','w'))
else:
    print("MISSING_FILES=NONE")
    json.dump([], open('/tmp/truly_missing.json','w'))
PYEOF
